+# Nemanja Hiršl <nemhirsl@gmail.com>, 2026.
+msgid ""
+msgstr ""
+"Project-Id-Version: kwin\n"
+"Report-Msgid-Bugs-To: https://bugs.kde.org\n"
+"POT-Creation-Date: 2026-08-04 00:46+0000\n"
+"PO-Revision-Date: 2026-10-02 20:50+0200\n"
+"Last-Translator: Nemanja Hiršl <nemhirsl@gmail.com>\n"
+"Language-Team: Serbian <kde-i18n-sr@kde.org>\n"
+"Language: sr\n"
+"MIME-Version: 1.0\n"
+"Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8\n"
+"Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit\n"
+"Plural-Forms: nplurals=4; plural=n==1 ? 3 : n%10==1 && n%100!=11 ? 0 : n"
+"%10>=2 && n%10<=4 && (n%100<10 || n%100>=20) ? 1 : 2;\n"
+"X-Accelerator-Marker: &\n"
+"X-Text-Markup: kde4\n"
+"X-Environment: kde\n"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:28
+#, kde-kuit-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"
+msgid ""
+"Legacy X11 apps with global shortcuts and other features accessed while "
+"running in the background need to be able to listen for keystrokes all the "
+"time.<nl/><nl/>If you use any of these apps, you can choose your preferred "
+"balance of security and compatibility here."
+msgstr ""
+"Стари икс11 програми са глобалним пречицама и другим могућностима којима се "
+"приступа док раде у позадини морају стално да слушају притиске тастера.<nl/"
+"><nl/>Ако користите неки од ових програма, овде можете изабрати жељени однос "
+"између безбедности и сагласности."
+
+#: ui/main.qml:49
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@title:group"
+msgid "Listening for keystrokes:"
+msgstr "Слушање притисака тастера:"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:52
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@option:radio Listening for keystrokes is prohibited"
+msgid "Prohibited"
+msgstr "Забрањено"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:61
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"
+msgid "Most secure; global shortcuts will not work in X11 apps"
+msgstr "Најбезбедније; глобалне пречице неће радити у икс11 програмима"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:67
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@option:radio Listening for keystrokes is allowed for…"
+msgid "Only the Meta, Control, Alt, and Shift keys"
+msgstr "Дозвољено само за тастере Meta, Control, Alt и Shift"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:76
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"
+msgid ""
+"High security; push-to-talk and other modifier-only global shortcuts will "
+"work in X11 apps"
+msgstr ""
+"Висока безбедност; „притисни за говор“ и друге глобалне пречице само од "
+"модификатора радиће у икс11 програмима"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:81
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@option:radio Listening for keystrokes is allowed for…"
+msgid ""
+"As above, plus any key pressed while the Control, Alt, or Meta key is also "
+"pressed"
+msgstr ""
+"Као изнад, плус за сваки тастер притиснут док је притиснут и Control, Alt "
+"или Meta"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:90
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"
+msgid "Moderate security; all global shortcuts will work in X11 apps"
+msgstr "Умерена безбедност; све глобалне пречице радиће у икс11 програмима"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:96
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@option:radio Listening for keystrokes is always allowed"
+msgid "Always allowed"
+msgstr "Увек дозвољено"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:105
+#, kde-format

+#, kde-format

+#: ui/main.qml:121

+
+#: ui/main.qml:130
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"

+"Moderate security; global shortcuts involving mouse buttons will work in X11 "

+

+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@action:button"
+msgid "See Allowed Applications…"
+msgstr "Погледај дозвољене програме…"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:167
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"
+msgid ""
+"Moderate security; XWayland-using apps claiming to be something on this list "
+"will be able to take control of the computer, because XWayland-using apps’ "
+"identities can’t be verified"
+msgstr ""
+"Умерена безбедност; програми који користе Икс‑вејланд и представљају се као "

+

+msgid "Least secure; all X11 apps will be able to take control of the computer"

+#, kde-format
+msgctxt ""
+"@title:window title of the page opened by the 'See allowed applications' "

+msgstr "Програми којима је дозвољено да управљају показивачем и тастатуром"

+#, kde-format

-#~| msgid ""
-#~| "<p>This option specifies how much KWin will try to prevent unwanted "
-#~| "focus stealing caused by unexpected activation of new windows. (Note: "
-#~| "This feature does not work with the Focus Under Mouse or Focus Strictly "
-#~| "Under Mouse focus policies.)\n"
-#~| "<ul>\n"
-#~| "<li><em>None:</em> Prevention is turned off and new windows always "
-#~| "become activated.</li>\n"
-#~| "<li><em>Low:</em> Prevention is enabled; when some window does not have "
-#~| "support for the underlying mechanism and KWin cannot reliably decide "
-#~| "whether to activate the window or not, it will be activated. This "
-#~| "setting may have both worse and better results than the medium level, "
-#~| "depending on the applications.</li>\n"
-#~| "<li><em>Medium:</em> Prevention is enabled.</li>\n"
-#~| "<li><em>High:</em> New windows get activated only if no window is "
-#~| "currently active or if they belong to the currently active application. "
-#~| "This setting is probably not really usable when not using mouse focus "
-#~| "policy.</li>\n"
-#~| "<li><em>Extreme:</em> All windows must be explicitly activated by the "
-#~| "user.</li>\n"
-#~| "</ul></p>\n"
-#~| "<p>Windows that are prevented from stealing focus are marked as "
-#~| "demanding attention, which by default means their taskbar entry will be "
-#~| "highlighted. This can be changed in the Notifications control module.</p>"

-#~ msgstr ""
-#~ "<p>Овом опцијом одређује се колико треба спречавати „крађу фокуса“ "
-#~ "приликом неочекиване активације нових прозора. <i>Напомена</i>: Ова "
-#~ "могућност не ради са смерницама „фокус испод миша“ и „фокус строго испод "
-#~ "миша“.</p><ul><li><i>никакав</i> — спречавање је искључено и нови прозори "
-#~ "увек бивају активирани.</li><li><i>низак</i> — спречавање је укључено; "
-#~ "када неки прозор не подржава коришћени механизам и не може се поуздано "
-#~ "одредити да ли га треба активирати или не, прозор ће бити активиран. Ова "
-#~ "поставка може дати и боље и горе резултате од средњег нивоа, у зависности "
-#~ "од програма.</li><li><i>средњи</i> — спречавање је укључено.</"
-#~ "li><li><i>висок</i> — нови прозори се активирају само ако ниједан прозор "
-#~ "није тренутно активан, или ако припадају тренутно активном програму. Ова "
-#~ "поставка вероватно није истински употребљива када се не користи смерница "
-#~ "фокусирања мишем.</li><li><i>екстреман</i> — корисник мора изричито да "
-#~ "активира сваки прозор.</li></ul><p>За прозоре спречене у крађи фокуса "
-#~ "јавља се да захтевају пажњу, што подразумевано значи да ће њихов унос у "
-#~ "траци задатака бити истакнут. Ово можете изменити у контролном модулу "
-#~ "обавештавања.</p>"

+# Nemanja Hiršl <nemhirsl@gmail.com>, 2026.
+msgid ""
+msgstr ""
+"Project-Id-Version: kwin\n"
+"Report-Msgid-Bugs-To: https://bugs.kde.org\n"
+"POT-Creation-Date: 2026-08-04 00:46+0000\n"
+"PO-Revision-Date: 2026-10-02 20:50+0200\n"
+"Last-Translator: Nemanja Hiršl <nemhirsl@gmail.com>\n"
+"Language-Team: Serbian <kde-i18n-sr@kde.org>\n"
+"Language: sr@ijekavian\n"
+"MIME-Version: 1.0\n"
+"Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8\n"
+"Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit\n"
+"Plural-Forms: nplurals=4; plural=n==1 ? 3 : n%10==1 && n%100!=11 ? 0 : n"
+"%10>=2 && n%10<=4 && (n%100<10 || n%100>=20) ? 1 : 2;\n"
+"X-Accelerator-Marker: &\n"
+"X-Text-Markup: kde4\n"
+"X-Environment: kde\n"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:28
+#, kde-kuit-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"
+msgid ""
+"Legacy X11 apps with global shortcuts and other features accessed while "
+"running in the background need to be able to listen for keystrokes all the "
+"time.<nl/><nl/>If you use any of these apps, you can choose your preferred "
+"balance of security and compatibility here."
+msgstr ""
+"Стари икс11 програми са глобалним пречицама и другим могућностима којима се "
+"приступа док раде у позадини морају стално да слушају притиске тастера.<nl/"
+"><nl/>Ако користите неки од ових програма, овдје можете изабрати жељени "
+"однос између безбједности и сагласности."
+
+#: ui/main.qml:49
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@title:group"
+msgid "Listening for keystrokes:"
+msgstr "Слушање притисака тастера:"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:52
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@option:radio Listening for keystrokes is prohibited"
+msgid "Prohibited"
+msgstr "Забрањено"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:61
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"
+msgid "Most secure; global shortcuts will not work in X11 apps"
+msgstr "Најбезбједније; глобалне пречице неће радити у икс11 програмима"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:67
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@option:radio Listening for keystrokes is allowed for…"
+msgid "Only the Meta, Control, Alt, and Shift keys"
+msgstr "Дозвољено само за тастере Meta, Control, Alt и Shift"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:76
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"
+msgid ""
+"High security; push-to-talk and other modifier-only global shortcuts will "
+"work in X11 apps"
+msgstr ""
+"Висока безбједност; „притисни за говор“ и друге глобалне пречице само од "
+"модификатора радиће у икс11 програмима"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:81
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@option:radio Listening for keystrokes is allowed for…"
+msgid ""
+"As above, plus any key pressed while the Control, Alt, or Meta key is also "
+"pressed"
+msgstr ""
+"Као изнад, плус за сваки тастер притиснут док је притиснут и Control, Alt "
+"или Meta"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:90
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"
+msgid "Moderate security; all global shortcuts will work in X11 apps"
+msgstr "Умјерена безбједност; све глобалне пречице радиће у икс11 програмима"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:96
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@option:radio Listening for keystrokes is always allowed"
+msgid "Always allowed"
+msgstr "Увијек дозвољено"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:105
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"
+msgid ""
+"Least secure; all X11 apps will be able to see any text you type into any "
+"application"
+msgstr ""
+"Најмање безбједно; сви икс11 програми моћи ће да виде сваки текст који "
+"укуцате у било који програм"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:111
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"
+msgid ""
+"Note that using this setting will reduce system security and permit "
+"malicious software to steal passwords and spy on the text that you type. "
+"Make sure you understand and accept this risk."
+msgstr ""
+"Имајте на уму да коришћење ове поставке смањује безбједност система и "
+"дозвољава злонамјерном софтверу да краде лозинке и уходи текст који куцате. "
+"Увјерите се да разумијете и прихватате овај ризик."
+
+#: ui/main.qml:118
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@title:group"
+msgid "Listening for mouse buttons:"
+msgstr "Слушање дугмади миша:"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:121
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@option:radio Listening for mouse buttons is allowed"
+msgid "Allowed"
+msgstr "Дозвољено"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:130
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"
+msgid ""
+"Moderate security; global shortcuts involving mouse buttons will work in X11 "
+"apps"
+msgstr ""
+"Умјерена безбједност; глобалне пречице које укључују дугмад миша радиће у "
+"икс11 програмима"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:141
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@title:group"
+msgid "Control of pointer and keyboard:"
+msgstr "Управљање показивачем и тастатуром:"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:146
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt ""
+"@option:check Allowed control of pointer and keyboard without asking for "
+"permissions for allowed apps"
+msgid "Allowed apps"
+msgstr "Дозвољени програми"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:156
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@action:button"
+msgid "See Allowed Applications…"
+msgstr "Погледај дозвољене програме…"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:167
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"
+msgid ""
+"Moderate security; XWayland-using apps claiming to be something on this list "
+"will be able to take control of the computer, because XWayland-using apps’ "
+"identities can’t be verified"
+msgstr ""
+"Умјерена безбједност; програми који користе Икс‑вејланд и представљају се "
+"као нешто са овог списка моћи ће да преузму управљање рачунаром, јер "
+"идентитет програма који користе Икс‑вејланд не може да се провјери"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:173
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt ""
+"@option:radio Allow control of pointer and keyboard without asking for "
+"permission"
+msgid "Allow without asking for permission"
+msgstr "Дозвољено без тражења одобрења"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:182
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"
+msgid "Least secure; all X11 apps will be able to take control of the computer"
+msgstr ""
+"Најмање безбједно; сви икс11 програми моћи ће да преузму управљање рачунаром"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:189
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"
+msgid ""
+"Note that using this setting will drastically reduce system security and "
+"permit malicious software to take complete control of your pointer and "
+"keyboard. Make sure you understand and accept this risk."
+msgstr ""
+"Имајте на уму да коришћење ове поставке драстично смањује безбједност "
+"система и дозвољава злонамјерном софтверу да преузме потпуно управљање вашим "
+"показивачем и тастатуром. Увјерите се да разумијете и прихватате овај ризик."
+
+#: ui/main.qml:197
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt ""
+"@title:window title of the page opened by the 'See allowed applications' "
+"button"
+msgid "Applications allowed to control the pointer and keyboard"
+msgstr "Програми којима је дозвољено да управљају показивачем и тастатуром"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:217
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@info:tooltip %1 is the name of the app/binary"
+msgid "Do not allow %1 to control the pointer and keyboard without asking"
+msgstr "Не дозволи да %1 управља показивачем и тастатуром без питања"

-#, fuzzy
-#~| msgid ""
-#~| "<p>This option specifies how much KWin will try to prevent unwanted "
-#~| "focus stealing caused by unexpected activation of new windows. (Note: "
-#~| "This feature does not work with the Focus Under Mouse or Focus Strictly "
-#~| "Under Mouse focus policies.)\n"
-#~| "<ul>\n"
-#~| "<li><em>None:</em> Prevention is turned off and new windows always "
-#~| "become activated.</li>\n"
-#~| "<li><em>Low:</em> Prevention is enabled; when some window does not have "
-#~| "support for the underlying mechanism and KWin cannot reliably decide "
-#~| "whether to activate the window or not, it will be activated. This "
-#~| "setting may have both worse and better results than the medium level, "
-#~| "depending on the applications.</li>\n"
-#~| "<li><em>Medium:</em> Prevention is enabled.</li>\n"
-#~| "<li><em>High:</em> New windows get activated only if no window is "
-#~| "currently active or if they belong to the currently active application. "
-#~| "This setting is probably not really usable when not using mouse focus "
-#~| "policy.</li>\n"
-#~| "<li><em>Extreme:</em> All windows must be explicitly activated by the "
-#~| "user.</li>\n"
-#~| "</ul></p>\n"
-#~| "<p>Windows that are prevented from stealing focus are marked as "
-#~| "demanding attention, which by default means their taskbar entry will be "
-#~| "highlighted. This can be changed in the Notifications control module.</p>"
-#~ msgid ""
-#~ "<html><head/><body><p>The placement policy determines where a new window "
-#~ "will appear on the desktop.</p><ul style=\"margin-top: 0px; margin-"
-#~ "bottom: 0px; margin-left: 0px; margin-right: 0px; -qt-list-indent: 1;"
-#~ "\"><li style=\" margin-top:12px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; "
-#~ "margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;\"><span style=\" "
-#~ "font-style:italic;\">Smart</span> will try to achieve a minimum overlap "
-#~ "of windows</li><li style=\" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-"
-#~ "left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;\"><span "
-#~ "style=\" font-style:italic;\">Maximizing</span> will try to maximize "
-#~ "every window to fill the whole screen. It might be useful to selectively "
-#~ "affect placement of some windows using the window-specific settings.</"
-#~ "li><li style=\" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; "
-#~ "margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;\"><span style=\" "
-#~ "font-style:italic;\">Random</span> will use a random position</li><li "
-#~ "style=\" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-"
-#~ "right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;\"><span style=\" font-"
-#~ "style:italic;\">Centered</span> will place the window centered</li><li "
-#~ "style=\" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-"
-#~ "right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;\"><span style=\" font-"
-#~ "style:italic;\">Zero-cornered</span> will place the window in the top-"
-#~ "left corner</li><li style=\" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:12px; margin-"
-#~ "left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;\"><span "

-#~ msgstr ""
-#~ "<p>Овом опцијом одређује се колико треба спречавати „крађу фокуса“ "
-#~ "приликом неочекиване активације нових прозора. <i>Напомена</i>: Ова "
-#~ "могућност не ради са смерницама „фокус испод миша“ и „фокус строго испод "
-#~ "миша“.</p><ul><li><i>никакав</i> — спречавање је искључено и нови прозори "
-#~ "увијек бивају активирани.</li><li><i>низак</i> — спречавање је укључено; "
-#~ "када неки прозор не подржава коришћени механизам и не може се поуздано "
-#~ "одредити да ли га треба активирати или не, прозор ће бити активиран. Ова "
-#~ "поставка може дати и боље и горе резултате од средњег нивоа, у зависности "
-#~ "од програма.</li><li><i>средњи</i> — спречавање је укључено.</"
-#~ "li><li><i>висок</i> — нови прозори се активирају само ако ниједан прозор "
-#~ "није тренутно активан, или ако припадају тренутно активном програму. Ова "
-#~ "поставка вјероватно није истински употребљива када се не користи "
-#~ "смјерница фокусирања мишем.</li><li><i>екстреман</i> — корисник мора "
-#~ "изричито да активира сваки прозор.</li></ul><p>За прозоре спријечене у "
-#~ "крађи фокуса јавља се да захтијевају пажњу, што подразумијевано значи да "
-#~ "ће њихов унос у траци задатака бити истакнут. Ово можете измијенити у "
-#~ "контролном модулу обавјештавања.</p>"

-#~| "whether to activate the window or not, it will be activated. This "
-#~| "setting may have both worse and better results than the medium level, "
-#~| "depending on the applications.</li>\n"
-#~| "<li><em>Medium:</em> Prevention is enabled.</li>\n"
-#~| "<li><em>High:</em> New windows get activated only if no window is "
-#~| "currently active or if they belong to the currently active application. "
-#~| "This setting is probably not really usable when not using mouse focus "
-#~| "policy.</li>\n"
-#~| "<li><em>Extreme:</em> All windows must be explicitly activated by the "
-#~| "user.</li>\n"
-#~| "</ul></p>\n"
-#~| "<p>Windows that are prevented from stealing focus are marked as "
-#~| "demanding attention, which by default means their taskbar entry will be "
-#~| "highlighted. This can be changed in the Notifications control module.</p>"

-#~ msgstr ""
-#~ "<p>Овом опцијом одређује се колико треба спречавати „крађу фокуса“ "
-#~ "приликом неочекиване активације нових прозора. <i>Напомена</i>: Ова "
-#~ "могућност не ради са смерницама „фокус испод миша“ и „фокус строго испод "
-#~ "миша“.</p><ul><li><i>никакав</i> — спречавање је искључено и нови прозори "
-#~ "увијек бивају активирани.</li><li><i>низак</i> — спречавање је укључено; "
-#~ "када неки прозор не подржава коришћени механизам и не може се поуздано "
-#~ "одредити да ли га треба активирати или не, прозор ће бити активиран. Ова "
-#~ "поставка може дати и боље и горе резултате од средњег нивоа, у зависности "
-#~ "од програма.</li><li><i>средњи</i> — спречавање је укључено.</"
-#~ "li><li><i>висок</i> — нови прозори се активирају само ако ниједан прозор "
-#~ "није тренутно активан, или ако припадају тренутно активном програму. Ова "
-#~ "поставка вјероватно није истински употребљива када се не користи "
-#~ "смјерница фокусирања мишем.</li><li><i>екстреман</i> — корисник мора "
-#~ "изричито да активира сваки прозор.</li></ul><p>За прозоре спријечене у "
-#~ "крађи фокуса јавља се да захтијевају пажњу, што подразумијевано значи да "
-#~ "ће њихов унос у траци задатака бити истакнут. Ово можете измијенити у "
-#~ "контролном модулу обавјештавања.</p>"

+# Nemanja Hiršl <nemhirsl@gmail.com>, 2026.
+msgid ""
+msgstr ""
+"Project-Id-Version: kwin\n"
+"Report-Msgid-Bugs-To: https://bugs.kde.org\n"
+"POT-Creation-Date: 2026-08-04 00:46+0000\n"
+"PO-Revision-Date: 2026-10-02 20:50+0200\n"
+"Last-Translator: Nemanja Hiršl <nemhirsl@gmail.com>\n"
+"Language-Team: Serbian <kde-i18n-sr@kde.org>\n"
+"Language: sr@ijekavianlatin\n"
+"MIME-Version: 1.0\n"
+"Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8\n"
+"Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit\n"
+"Plural-Forms: nplurals=4; plural=n==1 ? 3 : n%10==1 && n%100!=11 ? 0 : n"
+"%10>=2 && n%10<=4 && (n%100<10 || n%100>=20) ? 1 : 2;\n"
+"X-Accelerator-Marker: &\n"
+"X-Text-Markup: kde4\n"
+"X-Environment: kde\n"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:28
+#, kde-kuit-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"
+msgid ""
+"Legacy X11 apps with global shortcuts and other features accessed while "
+"running in the background need to be able to listen for keystrokes all the "
+"time.<nl/><nl/>If you use any of these apps, you can choose your preferred "
+"balance of security and compatibility here."
+msgstr ""
+"Stari X11 programi sa globalnim prečicama i drugim mogućnostima kojima se "
+"pristupa dok rade u pozadini moraju stalno da slušaju pritiske tastera.<nl/"
+"><nl/>Ako koristite neki od ovih programa, ovdje možete izabrati željeni "
+"odnos između bezbjednosti i saglasnosti."
+
+#: ui/main.qml:49
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@title:group"
+msgid "Listening for keystrokes:"
+msgstr "Slušanje pritisaka tastera:"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:52
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@option:radio Listening for keystrokes is prohibited"
+msgid "Prohibited"
+msgstr "Zabranjeno"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:61
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"
+msgid "Most secure; global shortcuts will not work in X11 apps"
+msgstr "Najbezbjednije; globalne prečice neće raditi u X11 programima"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:67
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@option:radio Listening for keystrokes is allowed for…"
+msgid "Only the Meta, Control, Alt, and Shift keys"
+msgstr "Dozvoljeno samo za tastere Meta, Control, Alt i Shift"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:76
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"
+msgid ""
+"High security; push-to-talk and other modifier-only global shortcuts will "
+"work in X11 apps"
+msgstr ""
+"Visoka bezbjednost; „pritisni za govor“ i druge globalne prečice samo od "
+"modifikatora radiće u X11 programima"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:81
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@option:radio Listening for keystrokes is allowed for…"
+msgid ""
+"As above, plus any key pressed while the Control, Alt, or Meta key is also "
+"pressed"
+msgstr ""
+"Kao iznad, plus za svaki taster pritisnut dok je pritisnut i Control, Alt "
+"ili Meta"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:90
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"
+msgid "Moderate security; all global shortcuts will work in X11 apps"
+msgstr "Umjerena bezbjednost; sve globalne prečice radiće u X11 programima"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:96
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@option:radio Listening for keystrokes is always allowed"
+msgid "Always allowed"
+msgstr "Uvijek dozvoljeno"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:105
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"
+msgid ""
+"Least secure; all X11 apps will be able to see any text you type into any "
+"application"
+msgstr ""
+"Najmanje bezbjedno; svi X11 programi moći će da vide svaki tekst koji "
+"ukucate u bilo koji program"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:111
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"
+msgid ""
+"Note that using this setting will reduce system security and permit "
+"malicious software to steal passwords and spy on the text that you type. "
+"Make sure you understand and accept this risk."
+msgstr ""
+"Imajte na umu da korišćenje ove postavke smanjuje bezbjednost sistema i "
+"dozvoljava zlonamjernom softveru da krade lozinke i uhodi tekst koji kucate. "
+"Uvjerite se da razumijete i prihvatate ovaj rizik."
+
+#: ui/main.qml:118
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@title:group"
+msgid "Listening for mouse buttons:"
+msgstr "Slušanje dugmadi miša:"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:121
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@option:radio Listening for mouse buttons is allowed"
+msgid "Allowed"
+msgstr "Dozvoljeno"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:130
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"
+msgid ""
+"Moderate security; global shortcuts involving mouse buttons will work in X11 "
+"apps"
+msgstr ""
+"Umjerena bezbjednost; globalne prečice koje uključuju dugmad miša radiće u "
+"X11 programima"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:141
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@title:group"
+msgid "Control of pointer and keyboard:"
+msgstr "Upravljanje pokazivačem i tastaturom:"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:146
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt ""
+"@option:check Allowed control of pointer and keyboard without asking for "
+"permissions for allowed apps"
+msgid "Allowed apps"
+msgstr "Dozvoljeni programi"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:156
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@action:button"
+msgid "See Allowed Applications…"
+msgstr "Pogledaj dozvoljene programe…"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:167
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"
+msgid ""
+"Moderate security; XWayland-using apps claiming to be something on this list "
+"will be able to take control of the computer, because XWayland-using apps’ "
+"identities can’t be verified"
+msgstr ""
+"Umjerena bezbjednost; programi koji koriste XWayland i predstavljaju se kao "
+"nešto sa ovog spiska moći će da preuzmu upravljanje računarom, jer identitet "
+"programa koji koriste XWayland ne može da se provjeri"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:173
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt ""
+"@option:radio Allow control of pointer and keyboard without asking for "
+"permission"
+msgid "Allow without asking for permission"
+msgstr "Dozvoljeno bez traženja odobrenja"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:182
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"
+msgid "Least secure; all X11 apps will be able to take control of the computer"
+msgstr ""
+"Najmanje bezbjedno; svi X11 programi moći će da preuzmu upravljanje računarom"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:189
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"
+msgid ""
+"Note that using this setting will drastically reduce system security and "
+"permit malicious software to take complete control of your pointer and "
+"keyboard. Make sure you understand and accept this risk."
+msgstr ""
+"Imajte na umu da korišćenje ove postavke drastično smanjuje bezbjednost "
+"sistema i dozvoljava zlonamjernom softveru da preuzme potpuno upravljanje "
+"vašim pokazivačem i tastaturom. Uvjerite se da razumijete i prihvatate ovaj "
+"rizik."
+
+#: ui/main.qml:197
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt ""
+"@title:window title of the page opened by the 'See allowed applications' "
+"button"
+msgid "Applications allowed to control the pointer and keyboard"
+msgstr "Programi kojima je dozvoljeno da upravljaju pokazivačem i tastaturom"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:217
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@info:tooltip %1 is the name of the app/binary"
+msgid "Do not allow %1 to control the pointer and keyboard without asking"
+msgstr "Ne dozvoli da %1 upravlja pokazivačem i tastaturom bez pitanja"

-#, fuzzy
-#~| msgid ""
-#~| "<p>This option specifies how much KWin will try to prevent unwanted "
-#~| "focus stealing caused by unexpected activation of new windows. (Note: "
-#~| "This feature does not work with the Focus Under Mouse or Focus Strictly "
-#~| "Under Mouse focus policies.)\n"
-#~| "<ul>\n"
-#~| "<li><em>None:</em> Prevention is turned off and new windows always "
-#~| "become activated.</li>\n"
-#~| "<li><em>Low:</em> Prevention is enabled; when some window does not have "
-#~| "support for the underlying mechanism and KWin cannot reliably decide "
-#~| "whether to activate the window or not, it will be activated. This "
-#~| "setting may have both worse and better results than the medium level, "
-#~| "depending on the applications.</li>\n"
-#~| "<li><em>Medium:</em> Prevention is enabled.</li>\n"
-#~| "<li><em>High:</em> New windows get activated only if no window is "
-#~| "currently active or if they belong to the currently active application. "
-#~| "This setting is probably not really usable when not using mouse focus "
-#~| "policy.</li>\n"
-#~| "<li><em>Extreme:</em> All windows must be explicitly activated by the "
-#~| "user.</li>\n"
-#~| "</ul></p>\n"
-#~| "<p>Windows that are prevented from stealing focus are marked as "
-#~| "demanding attention, which by default means their taskbar entry will be "
-#~| "highlighted. This can be changed in the Notifications control module.</p>"
-#~ msgid ""
-#~ "<html><head/><body><p>The placement policy determines where a new window "
-#~ "will appear on the desktop.</p><ul style=\"margin-top: 0px; margin-"
-#~ "bottom: 0px; margin-left: 0px; margin-right: 0px; -qt-list-indent: 1;"
-#~ "\"><li style=\" margin-top:12px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; "
-#~ "margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;\"><span style=\" "
-#~ "font-style:italic;\">Smart</span> will try to achieve a minimum overlap "
-#~ "of windows</li><li style=\" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-"
-#~ "left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;\"><span "
-#~ "style=\" font-style:italic;\">Maximizing</span> will try to maximize "
-#~ "every window to fill the whole screen. It might be useful to selectively "
-#~ "affect placement of some windows using the window-specific settings.</"
-#~ "li><li style=\" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; "
-#~ "margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;\"><span style=\" "
-#~ "font-style:italic;\">Random</span> will use a random position</li><li "
-#~ "style=\" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-"
-#~ "right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;\"><span style=\" font-"
-#~ "style:italic;\">Centered</span> will place the window centered</li><li "
-#~ "style=\" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-"
-#~ "right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;\"><span style=\" font-"
-#~ "style:italic;\">Zero-cornered</span> will place the window in the top-"
-#~ "left corner</li><li style=\" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:12px; margin-"
-#~ "left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;\"><span "
-#~ "style=\" font-style:italic;\">Under mouse</span> will place the window "
-#~ "under the pointer</li></ul></body></html>"
-#~ msgstr ""
-#~ "<p>Ovom opcijom određuje se koliko treba sprečavati „krađu fokusa“ "
-#~ "prilikom neočekivane aktivacije novih prozora. <i>Napomena</i>: Ova "
-#~ "mogućnost ne radi sa smernicama „fokus ispod miša“ i „fokus strogo ispod "
-#~ "miša“.</p><ul><li><i>nikakav</i> — sprečavanje je isključeno i novi "
-#~ "prozori uvijek bivaju aktivirani.</li><li><i>nizak</i> — sprečavanje je "

-#, fuzzy
-#~| msgid ""
-#~| "<p>This option specifies how much KWin will try to prevent unwanted "
-#~| "focus stealing caused by unexpected activation of new windows. (Note: "
-#~| "This feature does not work with the Focus Under Mouse or Focus Strictly "
-#~| "Under Mouse focus policies.)\n"
-#~| "<ul>\n"
-#~| "<li><em>None:</em> Prevention is turned off and new windows always "
-#~| "become activated.</li>\n"
-#~| "<li><em>Low:</em> Prevention is enabled; when some window does not have "
-#~| "support for the underlying mechanism and KWin cannot reliably decide "
-#~| "whether to activate the window or not, it will be activated. This "
-#~| "setting may have both worse and better results than the medium level, "
-#~| "depending on the applications.</li>\n"
-#~| "<li><em>Medium:</em> Prevention is enabled.</li>\n"
-#~| "<li><em>High:</em> New windows get activated only if no window is "
-#~| "currently active or if they belong to the currently active application. "
-#~| "This setting is probably not really usable when not using mouse focus "
-#~| "policy.</li>\n"
-#~| "<li><em>Extreme:</em> All windows must be explicitly activated by the "
-#~| "user.</li>\n"
-#~| "</ul></p>\n"
-#~| "<p>Windows that are prevented from stealing focus are marked as "
-#~| "demanding attention, which by default means their taskbar entry will be "
-#~| "highlighted. This can be changed in the Notifications control module.</p>"

-#~| msgid ""
-#~| "<b>Click To Focus - Mouse Precedence</b><br>\n"
-#~| "This is mostly the same as <i>Click To Focus</i><br><br>\n"
-#~| "If an active window has to be chosen by the system<br>\n"
-#~| "(eg. because the currently active one was closed) <br>\n"
-#~| "the window under the mouse is the preferred candidate.<br><br>\n"

-#~ "to focus</em>. If an active window has to be chosen by the system (eg. "
-#~ "because the currently active one was closed) the window under the mouse "
-#~ "is the preferred candidate. Unusual, but possible variant of <em>Click to "
-#~ "focus</em>."

-#~ "the focus. <em>Focus stealing prevention</em> takes place as usual. Think "
-#~ "as <em>Click to focus</em> just without having to actually click."

-#~ "<br /><br />Ovo ne važi za prozore koji se sami pojave pod mišem.<br /"

-#~| msgid ""
-#~| "<b>Focus Under Mouse</b><br>\n"
-#~| "The focus always remains on the window under the mouse.<br><br>\n"

-#~| "contradict the policy and <b>will not work</b>.<br><br>\n"

+# Nemanja Hiršl <nemhirsl@gmail.com>, 2026.
+msgid ""
+msgstr ""
+"Project-Id-Version: kwin\n"
+"Report-Msgid-Bugs-To: https://bugs.kde.org\n"
+"POT-Creation-Date: 2026-08-04 00:46+0000\n"
+"PO-Revision-Date: 2026-10-02 20:50+0200\n"
+"Last-Translator: Nemanja Hiršl <nemhirsl@gmail.com>\n"
+"Language-Team: Serbian <kde-i18n-sr@kde.org>\n"
+"Language: sr@latin\n"
+"MIME-Version: 1.0\n"
+"Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8\n"
+"Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit\n"
+"Plural-Forms: nplurals=4; plural=n==1 ? 3 : n%10==1 && n%100!=11 ? 0 : n"
+"%10>=2 && n%10<=4 && (n%100<10 || n%100>=20) ? 1 : 2;\n"
+"X-Accelerator-Marker: &\n"
+"X-Text-Markup: kde4\n"
+"X-Environment: kde\n"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:28
+#, kde-kuit-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"
+msgid ""
+"Legacy X11 apps with global shortcuts and other features accessed while "
+"running in the background need to be able to listen for keystrokes all the "
+"time.<nl/><nl/>If you use any of these apps, you can choose your preferred "
+"balance of security and compatibility here."
+msgstr ""
+"Stari X11 programi sa globalnim prečicama i drugim mogućnostima kojima se "
+"pristupa dok rade u pozadini moraju stalno da slušaju pritiske tastera.<nl/"
+"><nl/>Ako koristite neki od ovih programa, ovde možete izabrati željeni "
+"odnos između bezbednosti i saglasnosti."
+
+#: ui/main.qml:49
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@title:group"
+msgid "Listening for keystrokes:"
+msgstr "Slušanje pritisaka tastera:"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:52
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@option:radio Listening for keystrokes is prohibited"
+msgid "Prohibited"
+msgstr "Zabranjeno"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:61
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"
+msgid "Most secure; global shortcuts will not work in X11 apps"
+msgstr "Najbezbednije; globalne prečice neće raditi u X11 programima"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:67
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@option:radio Listening for keystrokes is allowed for…"
+msgid "Only the Meta, Control, Alt, and Shift keys"
+msgstr "Dozvoljeno samo za tastere Meta, Control, Alt i Shift"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:76
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"
+msgid ""
+"High security; push-to-talk and other modifier-only global shortcuts will "
+"work in X11 apps"
+msgstr ""
+"Visoka bezbednost; „pritisni za govor“ i druge globalne prečice samo od "
+"modifikatora radiće u X11 programima"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:81
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@option:radio Listening for keystrokes is allowed for…"
+msgid ""
+"As above, plus any key pressed while the Control, Alt, or Meta key is also "
+"pressed"
+msgstr ""
+"Kao iznad, plus za svaki taster pritisnut dok je pritisnut i Control, Alt "
+"ili Meta"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:90
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"
+msgid "Moderate security; all global shortcuts will work in X11 apps"
+msgstr "Umerena bezbednost; sve globalne prečice radiće u X11 programima"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:96
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@option:radio Listening for keystrokes is always allowed"
+msgid "Always allowed"
+msgstr "Uvek dozvoljeno"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:105
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"
+msgid ""
+"Least secure; all X11 apps will be able to see any text you type into any "
+"application"
+msgstr ""
+"Najmanje bezbedno; svi X11 programi moći će da vide svaki tekst koji ukucate "
+"u bilo koji program"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:111
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"
+msgid ""
+"Note that using this setting will reduce system security and permit "
+"malicious software to steal passwords and spy on the text that you type. "
+"Make sure you understand and accept this risk."
+msgstr ""
+"Imajte na umu da korišćenje ove postavke smanjuje bezbednost sistema i "
+"dozvoljava zlonamernom softveru da krade lozinke i uhodi tekst koji kucate. "
+"Uverite se da razumete i prihvatate ovaj rizik."
+
+#: ui/main.qml:118
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@title:group"
+msgid "Listening for mouse buttons:"
+msgstr "Slušanje dugmadi miša:"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:121
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@option:radio Listening for mouse buttons is allowed"
+msgid "Allowed"
+msgstr "Dozvoljeno"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:130
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"
+msgid ""
+"Moderate security; global shortcuts involving mouse buttons will work in X11 "
+"apps"
+msgstr ""
+"Umerena bezbednost; globalne prečice koje uključuju dugmad miša radiće u X11 "
+"programima"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:141
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@title:group"
+msgid "Control of pointer and keyboard:"
+msgstr "Upravljanje pokazivačem i tastaturom:"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:146
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt ""
+"@option:check Allowed control of pointer and keyboard without asking for "
+"permissions for allowed apps"
+msgid "Allowed apps"
+msgstr "Dozvoljeni programi"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:156
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@action:button"
+msgid "See Allowed Applications…"
+msgstr "Pogledaj dozvoljene programe…"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:167
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"
+msgid ""
+"Moderate security; XWayland-using apps claiming to be something on this list "
+"will be able to take control of the computer, because XWayland-using apps’ "
+"identities can’t be verified"
+msgstr ""
+"Umerena bezbednost; programi koji koriste XWayland i predstavljaju se kao "
+"nešto sa ovog spiska moći će da preuzmu upravljanje računarom, jer identitet "
+"programa koji koriste XWayland ne može da se proveri"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:173
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt ""
+"@option:radio Allow control of pointer and keyboard without asking for "
+"permission"
+msgid "Allow without asking for permission"
+msgstr "Dozvoljeno bez traženja odobrenja"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:182
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"
+msgid "Least secure; all X11 apps will be able to take control of the computer"
+msgstr ""
+"Najmanje bezbedno; svi X11 programi moći će da preuzmu upravljanje računarom"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:189
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@info:usagetip"
+msgid ""
+"Note that using this setting will drastically reduce system security and "
+"permit malicious software to take complete control of your pointer and "
+"keyboard. Make sure you understand and accept this risk."
+msgstr ""
+"Imajte na umu da korišćenje ove postavke drastično smanjuje bezbednost "
+"sistema i dozvoljava zlonamernom softveru da preuzme potpuno upravljanje "
+"vašim pokazivačem i tastaturom. Uverite se da razumete i prihvatate ovaj "
+"rizik."
+
+#: ui/main.qml:197
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt ""
+"@title:window title of the page opened by the 'See allowed applications' "
+"button"
+msgid "Applications allowed to control the pointer and keyboard"
+msgstr "Programi kojima je dozvoljeno da upravljaju pokazivačem i tastaturom"
+
+#: ui/main.qml:217
+#, kde-format
+msgctxt "@info:tooltip %1 is the name of the app/binary"
+msgid "Do not allow %1 to control the pointer and keyboard without asking"
+msgstr "Ne dozvoli da %1 upravlja pokazivačem i tastaturom bez pitanja"

-#, fuzzy
-#~| msgid ""
-#~| "<p>This option specifies how much KWin will try to prevent unwanted "
-#~| "focus stealing caused by unexpected activation of new windows. (Note: "
-#~| "This feature does not work with the Focus Under Mouse or Focus Strictly "
-#~| "Under Mouse focus policies.)\n"
-#~| "<ul>\n"
-#~| "<li><em>None:</em> Prevention is turned off and new windows always "
-#~| "become activated.</li>\n"
-#~| "<li><em>Low:</em> Prevention is enabled; when some window does not have "
-#~| "support for the underlying mechanism and KWin cannot reliably decide "
-#~| "whether to activate the window or not, it will be activated. This "
-#~| "setting may have both worse and better results than the medium level, "
-#~| "depending on the applications.</li>\n"
-#~| "<li><em>Medium:</em> Prevention is enabled.</li>\n"
-#~| "<li><em>High:</em> New windows get activated only if no window is "
-#~| "currently active or if they belong to the currently active application. "
-#~| "This setting is probably not really usable when not using mouse focus "
-#~| "policy.</li>\n"
-#~| "<li><em>Extreme:</em> All windows must be explicitly activated by the "
-#~| "user.</li>\n"
-#~| "</ul></p>\n"
-#~| "<p>Windows that are prevented from stealing focus are marked as "
-#~| "demanding attention, which by default means their taskbar entry will be "
-#~| "highlighted. This can be changed in the Notifications control module.</p>"
-#~ msgid ""
-#~ "<html><head/><body><p>The placement policy determines where a new window "
-#~ "will appear on the desktop.</p><ul style=\"margin-top: 0px; margin-"
-#~ "bottom: 0px; margin-left: 0px; margin-right: 0px; -qt-list-indent: 1;"
-#~ "\"><li style=\" margin-top:12px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; "
-#~ "margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;\"><span style=\" "
-#~ "font-style:italic;\">Smart</span> will try to achieve a minimum overlap "
-#~ "of windows</li><li style=\" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-"
-#~ "left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;\"><span "
-#~ "style=\" font-style:italic;\">Maximizing</span> will try to maximize "
-#~ "every window to fill the whole screen. It might be useful to selectively "
-#~ "affect placement of some windows using the window-specific settings.</"
-#~ "li><li style=\" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; "
-#~ "margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;\"><span style=\" "
-#~ "font-style:italic;\">Random</span> will use a random position</li><li "
-#~ "style=\" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-"
-#~ "right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;\"><span style=\" font-"
-#~ "style:italic;\">Centered</span> will place the window centered</li><li "
-#~ "style=\" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-"
-#~ "right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;\"><span style=\" font-"
-#~ "style:italic;\">Zero-cornered</span> will place the window in the top-"
-#~ "left corner</li><li style=\" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:12px; margin-"
-#~ "left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;\"><span "
-#~ "style=\" font-style:italic;\">Under mouse</span> will place the window "
-#~ "under the pointer</li></ul></body></html>"
-#~ msgstr ""
-#~ "<p>Ovom opcijom određuje se koliko treba sprečavati „krađu fokusa“ "
-#~ "prilikom neočekivane aktivacije novih prozora. <i>Napomena</i>: Ova "
-#~ "mogućnost ne radi sa smernicama „fokus ispod miša“ i „fokus strogo ispod "
-#~ "miša“.</p><ul><li><i>nikakav</i> — sprečavanje je isključeno i novi "
-#~ "prozori uvek bivaju aktivirani.</li><li><i>nizak</i> — sprečavanje je "
-#~ "uključeno; kada neki prozor ne podržava korišćeni mehanizam i ne može se "
-#~ "pouzdano odrediti da li ga treba aktivirati ili ne, prozor će biti "
-#~ "aktiviran. Ova postavka može dati i bolje i gore rezultate od srednjeg "
-#~ "nivoa, u zavisnosti od programa.</li><li><i>srednji</i> — sprečavanje je "
-#~ "uključeno.</li><li><i>visok</i> — novi prozori se aktiviraju samo ako "
-#~ "nijedan prozor nije trenutno aktivan, ili ako pripadaju trenutno aktivnom "
-#~ "programu. Ova postavka verovatno nije istinski upotrebljiva kada se ne "
-#~ "koristi smernica fokusiranja mišem.</li><li><i>ekstreman</i> — korisnik "
-#~ "mora izričito da aktivira svaki prozor.</li></ul><p>Za prozore sprečene u "
-#~ "krađi fokusa javlja se da zahtevaju pažnju, što podrazumevano znači da će "
-#~ "njihov unos u traci zadataka biti istaknut. Ovo možete izmeniti u "
-#~ "kontrolnom modulu obaveštavanja.</p>"

-#~| "depending on the applications.</li>\n"
-#~| "<li><em>Medium:</em> Prevention is enabled.</li>\n"
-#~| "<li><em>High:</em> New windows get activated only if no window is "
-#~| "currently active or if they belong to the currently active application. "
-#~| "This setting is probably not really usable when not using mouse focus "
-#~| "policy.</li>\n"
-#~| "<li><em>Extreme:</em> All windows must be explicitly activated by the "
-#~| "user.</li>\n"
-#~| "</ul></p>\n"
-#~| "<p>Windows that are prevented from stealing focus are marked as "
-#~| "demanding attention, which by default means their taskbar entry will be "
-#~| "highlighted. This can be changed in the Notifications control module.</p>"
-#~ msgid ""
-#~ "<html><head/><body><p>This option specifies how much KWin will try to "
-#~ "prevent unwanted focus stealing caused by unexpected activation of new "
-#~ "windows. (Note: This feature does not work with the <span style=\" font-"
-#~ "style:italic;\">Focus under mouse</span> or <span style=\" font-style:"
-#~ "italic;\">Focus strictly under mouse</span> focus policies.) </p><ul "
-#~ "style=\"margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; margin-left: 0px; margin-"
-#~ "right: 0px; -qt-list-indent: 1;\"><li style=\" margin-top:12px; margin-"
-#~ "bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-"
-#~ "indent:0px;\"><span style=\" font-style:italic;\">None:</span> Prevention "
-#~ "is turned off and new windows always become activated.</li><li style=\" "
-#~ "margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-"
-#~ "block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;\"><span style=\" font-style:italic;"
-#~ "\">Low:</span> Prevention is enabled; when some window does not have "
-#~ "support for the underlying mechanism and KWin cannot reliably decide "
-#~ "whether to activate the window or not, it will be activated. This setting "
-#~ "may have both worse and better results than the medium level, depending "
-#~ "on the applications.</li><li style=\" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; "
-#~ "margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"
-#~ "\"><span style=\" font-style:italic;\">Medium:</span> Prevention is "
-#~ "enabled.</li><li style=\" margin-top:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-"
-#~ "left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;\"><span "
-#~ "style=\" font-style:italic;\">High:</span> New windows get activated only "
-#~ "if no window is currently active or if they belong to the currently "
-#~ "active application. This setting is probably not really usable when not "
-#~ "using mouse focus policy.</li><li style=\" margin-top:0px; margin-"
-#~ "bottom:12px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-"
-#~ "indent:0px;\"><span style=\" font-style:italic;\">Extreme:</span> All "
-#~ "windows must be explicitly activated by the user.</li></ul><p>Windows "
-#~ "that are prevented from stealing focus are marked as demanding attention, "
-#~ "which by default means their taskbar entry will be highlighted. This can "
-#~ "be changed in the Notifications control module.</p></body></html>"
-#~ msgstr ""
-#~ "<p>Ovom opcijom određuje se koliko treba sprečavati „krađu fokusa“ "
-#~ "prilikom neočekivane aktivacije novih prozora. <i>Napomena</i>: Ova "
-#~ "mogućnost ne radi sa smernicama „fokus ispod miša“ i „fokus strogo ispod "
-#~ "miša“.</p><ul><li><i>nikakav</i> — sprečavanje je isključeno i novi "
-#~ "prozori uvek bivaju aktivirani.</li><li><i>nizak</i> — sprečavanje je "
-#~ "uključeno; kada neki prozor ne podržava korišćeni mehanizam i ne može se "
-#~ "pouzdano odrediti da li ga treba aktivirati ili ne, prozor će biti "
-#~ "aktiviran. Ova postavka može dati i bolje i gore rezultate od srednjeg "
-#~ "nivoa, u zavisnosti od programa.</li><li><i>srednji</i> — sprečavanje je "
-#~ "uključeno.</li><li><i>visok</i> — novi prozori se aktiviraju samo ako "
-#~ "nijedan prozor nije trenutno aktivan, ili ako pripadaju trenutno aktivnom "
-#~ "programu. Ova postavka verovatno nije istinski upotrebljiva kada se ne "
-#~ "koristi smernica fokusiranja mišem.</li><li><i>ekstreman</i> — korisnik "
-#~ "mora izričito da aktivira svaki prozor.</li></ul><p>Za prozore sprečene u "
-#~ "krađi fokusa javlja se da zahtevaju pažnju, što podrazumevano znači da će "
-#~ "njihov unos u traci zadataka biti istaknut. Ovo možete izmeniti u "
-#~ "kontrolnom modulu obaveštavanja.</p>"

-#~| "<b>Click To Focus</b><br>\n"

-#~ "This behavior is common on other operating systems and likely what you "
-#~ "want."
-#~ msgstr ""
-#~ "<b>Fokus klikom</b><br />Prozor postaje aktivan kada kliknete unutar "
-#~ "njega.<br /><br />Ovo je uobičajeno ponašanje za druge operativne "
-#~ "sisteme<br />i verovatno ono što želite."

-# >> @label
-#, fuzzy
-#~| msgid ""
-#~| "<b>Click To Focus - Mouse Precedence</b><br>\n"
-#~| "This is mostly the same as <i>Click To Focus</i><br><br>\n"
-#~| "If an active window has to be chosen by the system<br>\n"
-#~| "(eg. because the currently active one was closed) <br>\n"
-#~| "the window under the mouse is the preferred candidate.<br><br>\n"
-#~| "Unusual, but possible variant of <i>Click To Focus</i>."

-#~ "<em>Click to focus (mouse precedence):</em> Mostly the same as <em>Click "
-#~ "to focus</em>. If an active window has to be chosen by the system (eg. "
-#~ "because the currently active one was closed) the window under the mouse "
-#~ "is the preferred candidate. Unusual, but possible variant of <em>Click to "
-#~ "focus</em>."
-#~ msgstr ""
-#~ "<b>Fokus klikom, prednost mišu</b><br />Ovo je uglavnom isto kao fokus "

-#~ ">(npr. zbog zatvaranja tekućeg aktivnog),<br />onda prozor pod mišem ima "
-#~ "prednost.<br /><br />Neobična, ali moguća varijanta fokusa klikom."

-#~| msgid ""
-#~| "<b>Focus Follows Mouse</b><br>\n"
-#~| "Moving the mouse onto a window will activate it.<br><br>\n"

-#~| "<br>\n"
-#~| "Focus stealing prevention takes place as usual.<br><br>\n"

-#~ "the focus. <em>Focus stealing prevention</em> takes place as usual. Think "
-#~ "as <em>Click to focus</em> just without having to actually click."

-#~ "<b>Fokus prati miš</b><br />Prozor se aktivira kad se miš pomeri na njega."
-#~ "<br /><br />Ovo ne važi za prozore koji se sami pojave pod mišem.<br /"
-#~ ">Sprečavanje krađe fokusa radi kao i inače.<br /><br />Može se shvatiti "
-#~ "nalik fokusu klikom, samo bez klika."
-
-# >> @label
-#, fuzzy
-#~| msgid ""
-#~| "<b>Focus Follows Mouse - Mouse Precedence</b><br>\n"
-#~| "This is mostly the same as <i>Focus Follows Mouse</i><br><br>\n"
-#~| "If an active window has to be chosen by the system<br>\n"

-#~ "window has to be chosen by the system (eg. because the currently active "
-#~ "one was closed) the window under the mouse is the preferred candidate. "
-#~ "Choose this, if you want a hover controlled focus."
-#~ msgstr ""
-#~ "<b>Fokus prati miš, prednost mišu</b><br />Ovo je uglavnom isto kao kad "

-#~ "prozor<br />(npr. zbog zatvaranja tekućeg aktivnog),<br />onda prozor pod "

-# >> @label
-#, fuzzy
-#~| msgid ""
-#~| "<b>Focus Under Mouse</b><br>\n"
-#~| "The focus always remains on the window under the mouse.<br><br>\n"
-#~| "\n"
-#~| "Notice:<br>\n"
-#~| "<b>Focus stealing prevention</b> and the <b>tabbox (\"Alt+Tab\")</"
-#~| "b><br>\n"
-#~| "contradict the policy and <b>will not work</b>.<br><br>\n"
-#~| "You very likely want to use<br>\n"
-#~| "<i>Focus Follows Mouse - Mouse Precedence</i> instead!"
-#~ msgid ""
-#~ "<em>Focus under mouse:</em> The focus always remains on the window under "
-#~ "the mouse.<br/><strong>Warning:</strong> <em>Focus stealing prevention</"
-#~ "em> and the <em>tabbox ('Alt+Tab')</em> contradict the activation policy "
-#~ "and will not work. You very likely want to use <em>Focus follows mouse "
-#~ "(mouse precedence)</em> instead!"
-#~ msgstr ""
-#~ "<b>Fokus ispod miša</b><br />Fokus je uvek na prozoru pod mišem.<br /"
-#~ "><br />Sprečavanje krađe fokusa i menjanje prozora na Alt+Tab<br /"
-#~ ">sukobljeni su ovoj opciji, te <b>neće raditi</b>.<br /><br />Od ovoga će "
-#~ "vam vrlo verovatno više odgovarati da<br />fokus prati miš, uz prednost "
-#~ "mišu."

-#~| "The focus is always on the window under the mouse - in doubt nowhere -"

-#~| "environment.<br><br>\n"

-#~| "Notice:<br>\n"
-#~| "<b>Focus stealing prevention</b> and the <b>tabbox (\"Alt+Tab\")</"

-#~| "contradict the policy and <b>will not work</b>.<br><br>\n"
-#~| "You very likely want to use<br>\n"
-#~| "<i>Focus Follows Mouse - Mouse Precedence</i> instead!"

-#~ msgid ""
-#~ "<p><h1>Window Behavior</h1> Here you can customize the way windows behave "
-#~ "when being moved, resized or clicked on. You can also specify a focus "
-#~ "policy as well as a placement policy for new windows.</p> <p>Please note "
